notes.title: Update Notes For v1.1.2
notes.content:
1. Ending credits
- Add an ending artwork

2. System
- Fixed game startup language changing based on Steam UI language
- Fixed cinematic cutscene sound effects and background sounds to be separate

3. UI modifications
- Added Arrow Buttons to the Dialog UI
- Added ability to turn on/off the Use Superpowers UI in Preferences
- Adjusted spacing

4. Modify stages
- Added the ability for the first player to solve a quiz in the second half of Circuspace to see other players' cameras
- Added balloon popping sound effects to the Unipark background

5. Bug fixes
- Fixed bug with Rollercoaster Booster animation not syncing on client screen
- Fixed bug with synchronization of boss UI on client in Sky Castle (Boss Stage)
- Fixed bug where changing presets would be attempted multiple times when the preset selection field on the keyboard settings screen was manipulated with the keyboard

notes.title: Update Notes For v1.1.1
notes.content:
1. Game subtitle
 - Change game subtitle to "Animal Doll's Adventrue"

2. Modify stages
 - Fixed some unfriendly elements within the stage

3. UI modifications
 - Changed the color of the player's HP to differentiate between them.
 - When using superpowers, display controls in the lower left corner.
 - Add a button that allows users to press a menu button to see detailed instructions on how to operate it.

4. Resolution-specific UI
 - Fixed player's HP and nickname UI to have a constant ratio regardless of resolution.
 - Fixed the network ping number displayed in the top right corner of the screen to have a constant percentage regardless of resolution.
